The A/B counter producers reset on the corresponding pressed-button bits and increment only below 255. The attack predicate uses strict counter thresholds and short-circuits its alternate C-stick crossing predicate. It does not locally reset the counters. No fixed elapsed-frame buffer duration is proved.

The artifact's uncertainty about the neighboring cast named jobj is conservative but locally resolvable: DownBound.c line 169 assigns gobj->user_data to jobj before the Fighter casts at lines 193-196. The ordinary entry branch also resets both counters at lines 141-142. This does not require an owned-subject write or justify a whole-engine universal-entry assertion.
